The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Twin/Legends|twins]] [[Tiplee/Legends|Tiplee]] and [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]] were members of a '''humanoid sentient species'''. Their skin [[Color/Legends|color]] was red and green, respectively, and both had blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].

==Behind the scenes==
The species appears in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]]. The design was based off concept art for a female [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] that was cut from the film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="The Unknown trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-unknown-episode-guide|text="The Unknown" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>
